blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. Many existing adaptation methods are difficult to deploy in practice because they require access to source data or the internal parameters of the source model, which may be restricted by privacy, licensing, or security constraints. We present 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts a source-trained predictor to unlabeled target data using only black-box outputs. Our method performs pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and employs a weighted prediction module to fuse source logits with alignment logits, reducing sensitivity to noisy pseudo-labels. To stabilize prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete, we construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior from unlabeled target predictions and use it as a fallback for missing or unreliable class prototypes during alignment. Experiments on four corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. On ModelNet-40C, 3D-BBDA achieves mean errors of 32.08% (PointNet) and 29.62% (GDANet), outperforming Source-only (35.88% / 34.03%) and BFTT3D (33.78% / 32.36%). 3D-BBDA requires only a single forward pass with no gradient updates making it suitable for real-time, privacy-preserving deployment in transferable 3D recognition pipelines. Project page is available at https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA
blocks.zh: 强力3D点-云识别对机器人,绘图,和城市感知至关重要,然而点-云分级器往往会因传感器变化,环境变异,以及获取文物等导致域位转移而出现性能下降. 许多现有的适应方法在实践中难以应用,因为它们要求获得源数据或源模型的内部参数,而源数据或参数可能受到隐私、许可或安全限制的限制。 我们提出3D-BBDA,这是一种无反传播的黑盒域适应框架,它只使用黑盒输出来使一个源训练的预测器适应无标签的目标数据. 我们的方法进行伪标签制导原型对接,并使用一个加权预测模块来将源日志与配对日志连接起来,降低了对响亮的伪标签的敏感性. 为了在伪标签覆盖不完整时稳定原型内存,我们先从无标签的目标预测中构建出高斯-扰动原型,并在对齐时用作缺失或不可靠的类原型的倒置. 对被腐蚀的4个三维基准的实验表明,比起强基线,情况持续改善。 在ModelNet-40C上,3D-BBDA的平均误差为32.08%(PointNet)和29.62%(GDANet),优于纯源(35.88%/34.03%)和BFTT3D(33.78%/32.36%)。 3D-BBDA只需要一个单一的前进通路,没有梯度更新,使其适合在可转移的3D识别管中进行实时,隐私保留部署. 项目网页见https://visdomlab.github.io/3D_BBDA。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Robust 3D perception is fundamental to autonomous systems, including mobile robots, autonomous vehicles, unmanned aerial platforms, and urban mapping solutions. These systems rely heavily on point cloud data acquired from LiDAR, depth cameras, and other 3D sensors for object recognition, navigation, and interaction in unstructured environments. In real deployments, perception models often operate under changing environmental conditions, sensor variations, and acquisition artifacts that induce domain shifts, leading to significant performance degradation [ 19 , 21 ] . Ensuring robustness under such distributional shifts is critical for the safe and reliable deployment of AI-driven robotic systems.
blocks.zh: 强力3D感知对自主系统至关重要,包括移动机器人,自主车辆,无人驾驶航空平台,以及城市测绘解决方案等. 这些系统严重依赖从LiDAR获得的点云数据,深度相机,以及其他3D传感器,用于物体识别,导航,以及无结构环境中的相互作用. 在实际部署中,感知模型往往在不断变化的环境条件、传感器变化以及导致域位转移的获取文物下运行,导致显著性能退化[19,21]. 确保在这种分配转变下的稳健性对于安全可靠地部署AI驱动的机器人系统至关重要。

blocks.en: While unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) attempts to transfer knowledge from labeled source domains to unlabeled target domains [ 7 , 23 ] , most UDA methods require access to source data or source model parameters during adaptation [ 15 ] . In practical robotic deployments, this assumption is often unrealistic. Perception models may be proprietary, certified, or frozen after training, and source datasets may be inaccessible due to privacy, storage, or licensing constraints [ 20 ] . Moreover, online gradient-based fine-tuning is frequently infeasible on edge robotic platforms due to computational and safety considerations. These limitations motivate black-box and source-free adaptation strategies that rely on inference-time observations.
blocks.zh: 虽然无监督域适应(UDA)试图将知识从有标签的源域转移到无标签的目标域[7,23],但大多数UDA方法要求在适应过程中获取源数据或源模型参数[15]. 在实际的机器人部署中,这种假设往往是不现实的. 认知模型可能是专有的,认证的,或培训后被冻结的,由于隐私,存储,或许可限制,源数据集可能无法访问[20]. 此外,由于计算和安全方面的考虑,在线梯度微调往往在边缘机器人平台上不可行。 这些限制刺激了依靠推断时间观测的黑箱和无源适应战略.

blocks.en:
Black-Box Domain Adaptation (BBDA) addresses this setting by treating the source model as an immutable predictor and adapting only through its outputs [ 16 , 15 , 11 ] . However, existing BBDA research has primarily focused on 2D vision tasks. Extending BBDA to 3D point clouds is non-trivial due to unordered structures, irregular spatial distributions, and varying density patterns. Furthermore, existing approaches often depend on backpropagation or source statistics for alignment, limiting their applicability in strictly constrained deployment scenarios.
These highlight a critical research gap, necessitating novel approaches tailored to the unique characteristics of 3D point clouds under black-box constraints.
Additionally, these methods typically enforce the use of the same network architecture as the source model, which restricts the flexibility to adopt different architectures for the target model during adaptation [ 15 , 33 ] . This limitation hinders the ability to tailor target networks to specific tasks or computational constraints.
blocks.zh:
Black-Box域适应(BBDA)通过将源模型视为不可改变的预测器,并仅通过其输出[16、15、11]来适应这一设置。 然而,现有的BBDA研究主要侧重于2D愿景任务. 将 BBDA 延伸至 三维点云是无序结构,空间分布不规则,密度模式不一而为非三角. 此外,现有办法往往依赖反向传播或源统计数据来调整,限制了在严格受限制的部署情景中的适用性。
这些都凸显出一个关键的研究差距,需要针对3D点云在黑盒限制下的独特性量身定制出新的方法.
此外,这些方法通常强制使用与源模型相同的网络架构,这限制了在适应过程中为目标模型采用不同架构的灵活性[15,33]. 这一限制妨碍了使目标网络适应具体任务或计算限制的能力。

blocks.en: The self-training generates pseudo-labels of the target and adapts the network with re-training, however, learning with pseudo-labels leads to error accumulation which degrades the performance of the model. To handle this issue, some of the existing work leverages back-propagation free approach for getting the adaptive prediction at the time of inference [ 27 , 36 ] . However, the use of source data for the alignment makes it non-feasible.
blocks.zh: 自我训练产生目标的伪标签并用再训练来使网络适应,然而,用伪标签来学习会导致错误积累,从而降低模型的性能. 为了处理这一问题,一些现有的工作利用了回向传播的自由方法,在推论时获得适应性预测[27,36]. 然而,使用源数据进行对齐使其不可行.

The BBDA setting for 3D point cloud data remains largely unexplored within domain adaptation research, illustrated in Fig. 1 .

Unlike conventional domain adaptation approaches that rely on access to both source data and the corresponding model, the black-box paradigm restricts access solely to the pre-trained source model, which is treated as an immutable black box(Table 1 ).

blocks.en:
In this work, we address a stricter and practically motivated setting. We propose a novel Backpropagation-free Black-box Domain Adaptation framework for 3D point cloud data ( 3D-BBDA ), that performs adaptation without accessing source data or source model internals and without updating any parameters at test-time.
By avoiding parameter updates, the model eliminates the risk of error accumulation that could degrade performance over time. The source model is treated purely as a black-box predictor. The goal is to reduce domain gap between source and target domains.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们处理一个更加严格和具有实际动机的环境。 我们提议为3D点云数据(3D-BBDA)建立一个小说"Backpropagation-free Black-box域名适应框架",在不访问源数据或源模型内部,也不在测试时更新任何参数的情况下进行适应.
通过避免参数更新,该模型消除了错误积累的风险,这些错误积累可能会随着时间的推移降解性能. 源模型纯粹被当作黑箱预测器处理. 目标是缩小源域和目标域之间的域间差距.

blocks.en: A prototype-based alignment module is leveraged to align the feature space of the source and target domains. A non-parametric network is used to extract features from the target samples. For each corruption, the features from the target samples are extracted using a non-parametric network, and they are assigned labels based on the pseudo labels obtained from the pre-trained source model through the assumption that the pseudo labels are the ground truth. Based on these pseudo-labels, the prototype for each class is generated by taking the mean features corresponding to each label. Further, these class-wise prototypes are used to align the samples. To avoid losing information from the source domain, a weighted prediction module is used to obtain the final prediction by integrating the source model and the non-parametric network.
blocks.zh: 利用基于原型的对接模块来调整源域和目标域的特征空间。 一个非参数网络用于从目标样品中提取特征. 对于每种腐败,目标样品的特征都使用非参数网络取出,并且通过假设伪标签为地上真,根据从预训源模型得到的伪标签来指定标签. 基于这些伪标签,每个类的原型通过取出与每个标签对应的平均值来生成. 此外,这些分级的原型用于对标。 为了避免从源域丢失信息,使用了加权预测模块来通过整合源模型和非参数网络来得到最终预测.

blocks.en:
To ensure stability under sparse or incomplete pseudo-label assignments, we further construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior that provides fallback class prototypes when target pseudo-label coverage is missing or unreliable. Finally, a weighted prediction module fuses source predictions with alignment-based predictions, balancing source generalization with target-specific correction while avoiding error accumulation. The resulting framework requires no source data, no source-model parameter access, and no gradient updates, making it suitable for privacy-preserving and deployment-constrained 3D recognition.
The main contributions are summarized as: • We formulate and address backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation for 3D point cloud recognition, under strict source-free and parameter-free constraints motivated by robotic deployment scenarios. • We propose a pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment module for adapting target features without accessing source data or source model internals. • We introduce a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior that stabilizes prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete under severe target shifts. • We conduct extensive experiments across multiple corrupted 3D benchmarks, demonstrating consistent robustness gains with negligible inference overhead.
blocks.zh:
为了确保在很少或不完整的假标签任务下的稳定,我们进一步构建了高斯-扰动原型,在目标伪标签覆盖缺失或不可靠时提供倒置类原型. 最后,加权预测模块将源的预测与基于对齐的预测相接而成,平衡源的概括与特定目标的校正,同时避免出错累积. 由此形成的框架不需要源数据,没有源模型参数访问,也没有梯度更新,使其适合隐私保存和部署受约束的3D识别.
主要贡献概括为: • 我们制定并处理3D点云识别的回向无黑盒域适应,在机器人部署情景所激发的严格的无源和无参数限制下进行. 我们提议在不访问源数据或源模型内部的情况下,为适应目标特性而采用伪标签制导原型对接模块。 我们引进了高斯-扰动原型,在严重的目标转移下,假标签覆盖不完整时稳定原型内存。 我们进行了广泛的实验,跨越多个被腐蚀的三维基准,显示了持续的稳健性收益和微不足道的推论间接费用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep architectures such as PointNet [ 18 ] , and GDANet [ 30 ] , as well as recent transformer-based models (DAPoinTr [ 14 ] , and P3Former [ 29 ] ), achieve strong in-domain performance but can be brittle under distribution shifts (e.g., sensor noise, occlusion, density changes, corruption), motivating adaptation for robust deployment.
blocks.zh: PointNet [18],和GDANet [30]等深层建筑,以及以变压器为基础的近期模型(DAPoinTr [14],和P3Former [29]),都实现了强大的域内性能,但在分布转移(如感应噪声,隐蔽,密度变化,腐败等)下却可能变得不易,激发了对强力部署的适应.

blocks.en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) aligns labeled source and unlabeled target domains, leveraging geometric priors and self-training, e.g., SRDAN [ 35 ] , graph-based self-distillation [ 2 ] , and FAST3D [ 6 ] . However, UDA typically requires source data and often access to model internals, which may be infeasible under privacy, licensing constraints, or data portability constraints. Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) relaxes the source-data requirement but commonly still relies on access to source-model components and pseudo-labeling, which can suffer from confirmation bias and error accumulation.
blocks.zh: 未受监督域的适应(UDA)将被标记的源和被标记的目标域对接,利用几何前缀和自修,如SRDAN [35],以图表为基础的自去除[2],和FAST3D [6]. 然而,UDA通常需要源数据,而且经常需要访问模型内部,在隐私,许可限制或数据可移植性限制下,模型内部可能不可行. 无源域适应(SFDA)放宽了源数据要求,但通常仍然依赖于对源模型组件和伪标签的访问,这可能会受到确认偏差和错误积累的影响.

blocks.en: BBDA further restricts the setting by allowing only black-box predictions from the source model while prohibiting source data. Prior BBDA/SFDA approaches study augmentation and self-learning with uncertainty-aware filtering [ 11 , 8 ] and teacher/prototype mechanisms to mitigate noisy labels and forgetting [ 5 , 9 , 12 ] . Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts models using unlabeled test data; in 3D, recent work explores reconstruction/augmentation and prototype-based strategies [ 25 , 24 , 10 , 37 ] . Closest to our deployment constraints, BFTT3D [ 27 ] performs backpropagation-free 3D test-time adaptation via prototype memory for feature alignment, but it uses source data to build the prototype memory. It has conflicts with strict source-free and privacy-constrained deployment.
blocks.zh: BBDA进一步限制设置,只允许从源模型中进行黑盒预测,同时禁止源数据. 以往的BBDA/SFDA方法研究增强和自我学习,同时对不确定性有意识的过滤[11、8]和教师/原型机制进行研究,以减少吵闹的标签和忘记[5、9、12]。 试验时间适应(TTA)使用无标签的试验数据来适应模型;在3D中,最近的工作探索了重建/增强和以原型为基础的战略[25,24,10,37]. 最接近于我们的部署限制,BFTT3D[27]通过原型内存来进行无回传播的3D测试时间适应,用于特性对接,但它使用源数据来构建原型内存. 它与严格的无源和隐私限制的部署有冲突.

blocks.en:
In contrast, we address a stricter and practically motivated regime: backpropagation-free black-box adaptation for 3D point clouds , requiring neither source data nor source-model internals (or gradient updates), while improving robustness under corrupted target conditions, and architecture-agnostic adaptation strategies.

blocks.en: 3.4 Weighted Prediction Module
blocks.zh: 3.4 加权预测模块

blocks.en:
In order to make our framework robust against the limited number of target samples, using alone the prediction from the alignment module might not work well as it deals with target features only. And we do not want to lose the information of the source model as it will be helpful in cases, where our target sample is close in distribution to the source domain. Additionally, using only the output from the source model might not work well due to the internal covariate shift arising because of the domain gap in source and target distribution.
Thus, in order to incorporate the prediction from both, the source model and the alignment module, we adopt a weighted prediction module as: l final = λ ⋅ l s + ( 1 − λ ) ⋅ l a ​ m l_{\text{final}}=\lambda\cdot l_{s}+(1-\lambda)\cdot l_{am} (14) Here, l s l_{s} is the logits obtained from the pre-trained source model, l a ​ m l_{am} is the logits obtained from the alignment module, l f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ l l_{final} is the final logit which will be used for prediction, and λ \lambda is the weight assigned to the prediction from the source model.
We use a predefined λ \lambda because we wanted to intentionally assign less weight to the source model’s predictions to reduce the impact of noisy labels on the final prediction.
We treat λ \lambda as a fixed hyperparameter controlling the
contribution of the source prediction. The originally reported
benchmark-specific values were selected through one-time offline
validation sweeps analogous to Table 6 and were subsequently kept
fixed for all samples and corruption types within each benchmark.
This validation uses labels only for offline hyperparameter selection
and is not part of the adaptation pipeline; no target labels are
accessed during pseudo-label generation, prototype construction,
alignment, or inference.
To assess whether 3D-BBDA depends on benchmark-specific selection,
we additionally fix a single global λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 and transfer it
unchanged across datasets. This setting still improves Source-only
by +3.67, +1.06, and +2.76 percentage points on ModelNet40-C,
ScanObjectNN-C, and ShapeNet-C, respectively (Table 7 ).
Table 11 shows that this strategy makes our framework less sensitive to noisy predictions.

blocks.en: 5 Results & Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 成果和讨论

blocks.en: ModelNet-40C
blocks.zh: 示范网-40C

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports corruption robustness on ModelNet-40C. With PointNet, 3D-BBDA achieves lowest mean error ( 32.08% ), improving over Source-only (35.88%) and BFTT3D (33.78%). Gains are particularly pronounced under challenging geometric and sensing shifts, including rotation (59.56 vs. 68.56), distortion (28.68 vs. 34.04), and impulse (25.49 vs. 31.93). With GDANet, 3D-BBDA further reduces mean error to 29.62% , outperforming Source-only (34.03%) and BFTT3D (32.36%). The strongest improvement occur under difficult corruptions such as occlusion (58.62 vs. 63.32) and lidar (67.40 vs. 72.06), showing that 3D-BBDA is effective across backbones. ScanObjectNN-C Table 3 summarizes results on ScanObjectNN-C, which exhibits stronger real-scan characteristics and larger shifts. Despite the increased difficulty, 3D-BBDA achieves the best mean error from 60.30% to 59.48% on PointNet and from 66.16% to 65.64% on GDANet. Improvements are consistent across many corruptions (e.g., uniform : − 1.04 % -1.04\% on PointNet and − 1.22 % -1.22\% on GDANet vs. BFTT3D), indicating stable adaptation even when pseudo-label noise is higher.
We note that several UDA/SFDA baselines in Table 3 allow source access and/or gradient-based updates, which are outside our strict black-box, source-free, and backpropagation-free setting, prioritizing privacy-preserving adaptation and architectural flexibility. ShapeNet-C Table 4 shows that 3D-BBDA generalizes to the larger-scale ShapeNet-C benchmark. With PointNet trained from scratch, 3D-BBDA reduces mean error from 35.86% (Source-only) to 32.74% and improves over BFTT3D (33.40%), with notable gains under RBF/RBF-inv, shear, and distance shifts. With GDANet, 3D-BBDA achieves the lowest mean error ( 22.85% ) compared to Source-only (23.74%), while BFTT3D degrades substantially (40.12%), suggesting that source-dependent prototype construction can be brittle when transferring across datasets and backbones.
These results indicate that 3D-BBDA delivers more stable, backbone-robust adaptation under strict source-free constraints, while remaining competitive across a wide range of realistic corruption patterns.

blocks.en: 6 Ablation Analysis

blocks.en:
Analysis of Module Contributions Through λ \lambda Table 8 analyzes the contribution of each component by varying λ \lambda (Eq. 14 ). Case 1 ( λ = 1 \lambda=1 ): Using only the source model predictions yields a mean error of 35.86% , corresponding to the source-only baseline. Case 2 ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ): Relying solely on the alignment module increases the mean error to 54.45% , indicating that alignment without the source prior is unstable under severe corruption. Case 3 ( 0 < λ < 1 0<\lambda<1 ): Combining both components reduces the mean error to 32.08% , outperforming either module individually.
These results validate that the source model provides stable predictions when the target distribution is close to the source, while the alignment module captures domain-specific shifts. Their weighted fusion effectively balances generalization and adaptation, thereby improving robustness to corruption.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We proposed 3D-BBDA , a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework for 3D point cloud classification that requires neither source data nor source model internals. The method combines pseudo-label guided prototype alignment with a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior completion strategy to stabilize adaptation under sparse pseudo-labels, and a weighted prediction module to balance source priors with target-specific correction. Experiments on multiple corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent robustness gains with minimal overhead, enabling real-time and privacy-preserving deployment. We validate robustness and real-time feasibility via standard corruption benchmarks and inference overhead measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们提议了3D-BBDA,一个用于3D点云分类的回放无黑箱域适应框架,不需要源数据,也不需要源模型内部. 该方法结合了伪标签制导原型与高斯环绕式先行完成战略以稳定在稀有伪标签下进行适应,并结合了加权预测模块以平衡源前作与特定目标校正. 多项被腐蚀的三维基准的实验显示,在最低的间接费用下,不断取得稳健性,从而能够进行实时和保密部署。 我们通过标准腐败基准和推断间接费用的衡量来验证稳健性和实时可行性。

representations together with prototype-based shared-subspace
alignment. The primary methodological distinction is therefore not
the introduction of a completely new subspace-alignment objective,
but the reformulation of this pipeline under a stricter source-free,
logits-only black-box interface. Table 4 summarizes the component-wise relationship.

The distinction in Table 4 also clarifies which
parts of the pipeline are retained rather than newly derived.

available to this alignment: source-derived memory is removed and
replaced by pseudo-label-guided target prototypes, missing classes

the resulting alignment prediction is fused with the black-box source
prediction. These changes are what enable the alignment framework to
operate under the joint source-free, black-box, and
backpropagation-free constraints.

For comparability, DINE-3D uses the same frozen PointNN target
representation used by 3D-BBDA. We retain the principal optimization

blocks.en:
LN-TTA is a recent backpropagation-free test-time adaptation method
designed for Transformer-based point-cloud architectures. Its
adaptation mechanism relies on LayerNorm-related representations and
Transformer-specific tokens, including the CLS token. In contrast,
the PointNet and GDANet backbones used in our main experiments are
BatchNorm-based architectures and do not provide these
Transformer-specific representations.

blocks.en:

PointNet/GDANet evaluation protocol. A numerical comparison would
require either replacing the source backbone with a Transformer or
modifying LN-TTA to operate on representations for which its original
adaptation mechanism was not defined. Such a comparison would therefore
conflate the adaptation method with a change in backbone or constitute
a non-equivalent reimplementation.
